card: ALIAS: Trino-Viscount — high-nobility title, medallion, and three billion kiblars awarded by the imperial court following the Golden Planet battle
ALIAS: Metabaron's heroic baby — designation applied by the imperial court at the award ceremony

ROLE: Aghora's child; born into the Metabaron lineage and declared at the naming to be destined for perfect warrior and supreme technopope before any capacity to receive or refuse that identity exists
TRAIT: Unusually alert and adult-like in expression for a newborn — wide-eyed, still, without the distress response expected in active danger
TRAIT: Born during the Zombra assault on Rock Dragonis; survived combat at the moment of birth without distress
TRAIT: Diamond-bright glowing eyes, observable in moments of intensity

TRAIT: Crawled unharmed through crossing mental beams between Aghora and an androgynous monkey-like figure at the Golden Planet; the psychic attacking force was destroyed in the aftermath, though no causal link is confirmed
TRAIT: Escaped Flos aboard the Metacraft with Aghora; fed artificial milk because Aghora could not nurse — entirely dependent, no self-sufficiency
VOICE: The laugh is adult in cadence; those present treat it as significant rather than as reflexive infant sound
RELATIONSHIP: aghora (Aghora): father-mother parent; withholds a personal name as a deliberate act of designation and declares a destiny the child cannot yet consent to or refuse
INSTRUCTION: Infant only; do not attribute intent, strategy, memory, or self-understanding beyond externally witnessed effects.
BOUNDARY: The declared destiny — perfect warrior, supreme technopope — is a weight placed before there is anyone to carry it; what that becoming costs lies entirely ahead.
BOUNDARY: Has no lived memory of harsh training or a right-eyebrow scar; do not write later Sans-Nom biography as present identity.
